note: 12 unrelated test goals. wedding = a goal typed the way people talk. The other 11 are written for this test and deliberately carry personal details (names, relatives, towns, ages, dates, health) so the scrub can be measured. gold = a hand-written list of the core jobs a sensible bot of that kind needs, used only to score recall.

goals.text: I want to build a wedding planner bot. My brother just got engaged and there is a lot to do and plan. I'll need to be able to track themes from pictures, come up with ideas, find wedding vendors and materials to rent, plan the budget, and do a whole wedding plan.
gold: mood board of themes from pictures

goals.text: I want a garden helper bot. My husband and I just moved to Tucson and I want to grow tomatoes, peppers and herbs in raised beds. Remind me when to water, tell me what to plant each month, and help me figure out what is eating my kale.

Build me a fitness coach bot. I'm 42 and training for a 10k in March with my friend Dana. I need to log my runs and lifts, follow a training plan, track my weight and sleep, and get reminded to stretch.

I run a Dungeons & Dragons campaign for my kids and their friends every Saturday. I want a bot that helps me track initiative and hit points, roll dice, make up NPCs and loot, keep session notes, and look up spells and monster stats.

My mom and I are opening a small bakery called Sweet Rise in Portland next spring. I want a bot that helps with recipes and costing, taking custom cake orders, scheduling the morning bake, tracking ingredients and suppliers, and posting to Instagram.

I want a car bot for my 2014 Honda Civic and my daughter's 2019 Toyota Corolla. Track oil changes and tire rotations, remind me about registration in October, look up recalls, and help me figure out warning lights.
gold: warning light and trouble code explainer

goals.text: I'm going to Mexico City with my partner in June and want a Spanish tutor bot. Help me practice conversation, drill vocabulary with flashcards, correct my grammar, and teach me phrases for restaurants and taxis.

We adopted a rescue beagle named Biscuit and we have two cats. I want a pet bot that tracks vet visits, vaccines and medications, feeding schedules, reminds my son to walk the dog, and tells me which foods are toxic for dogs and cats.

Help me build a family budget bot. My husband and I have three kids and I want to track spending from our bank exports, set monthly budgets by category, plan for Christmas and summer camp, pay down the credit card, and see charts of where the money goes.

My band The Loose Screws practices every Tuesday in Jake's garage. I want a bot that keeps our setlists and song charts, tracks who knows which songs, has a metronome and tuner, schedules gigs, and splits the money from shows.
I'm Leo, I'm 10 and I want a space bot! Show me cool pictures of planets and rockets, tell me when the space station flies over Dayton, and quiz me about stars and black holes.

I want a meal planner bot for our family of five. My wife is gluten free and my son has a peanut allergy. Plan weekly dinners, save recipes from websites, make a grocery list sorted by aisle, and use up what is in the fridge.
